from_speaker: was let go from OpenAI’s board
none of the new members of the board
a similar background in AI ethics
our_interpretation: Assess the factual assertions, not whether the changes were worrisome.
Read 'let go' as losing her board position during the negotiated reconstitution of the board. It does not necessarily mean a formal dismissal.

Read 'similar background' as an established professional specialization in AI safety, responsible AI, or AI policy comparable to Toner's research and policy work. General technology leadership, legal experience, and corporate governance do not by themselves establish that specialization.
The relevant new directors are Bret Taylor, Larry Summers, Sue Desmond-Hellmann, Nicole Seligman, and Fidji Simo. Sam Altman's return is also considered; Adam D'Angelo was a continuing director.

The target period covers Toner's November 2023 departure and subsequent appointments through publication. For the ongoing board composition, use the latest appointment announcement before the post, dated March 8, 2024.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish Toner's departure during the board reconstitution, and the appointees' documented professional histories show no comparable specialization in AI ethics, safety, or policy.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Toner retained her seat, or at least one relevant appointee had an established comparable professional specialization by April 17, 2024.
